preconditions.description: The input string must be non-empty and have a length of at most 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABC.' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string must only contain the characters 'A', 'B', 'C', and '.'.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: any('A' in s and 'B' in s and 'C' in s)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', there must be at least one cell that can contain all three colours after some flowers shed their petals.
